# Third-Party Provenance and Attribution

`DemaConsulting.CanvasNet.Mermaid` implements the Mermaid text language. The package is **derived with
attribution**: to draw diagrams the way Mermaid draws them, its preprocessing, diagram detection, parsers,
configuration defaults, themes and layout are ports of the projects listed below. Every ported item is acknowledged
here, the license texts of the upstream projects ship with the package (in its `licenses\` folder), and every source
file that contains ported logic starts with the header comment
`// Portions derived from <project> (<license>); see third-party/README.md`. Ported code is local source code, maintained
and tested in this repository; no upstream package is a dependency.

This project is **not affiliated with, and is not endorsed or promoted by**, the Mermaid project, its authors or the
authors of js-yaml, khroma, dagre, graphlib, dagre-d3-es, lodash, marked or d3. The names are used only to describe the language that is implemented.

## Original work

The public API, the location map, the scene model and painter (`Scenegraph/`), the picture loading of `NodeImages`
(`Rendering/`), the named character references of `HtmlEntities` (`Syntax/`, the 252 references of the HTML 4
specification and five HTML 5 names), the CSS declaration subset of
`StyleDeclarations` (`Configuration/`), the HTML clean-up of `HtmlSanitizer` (`Syntax/`, which reproduces the
results of DOMPurify, the sanitizer Mermaid uses, for the inline HTML of labels; the element and attribute names it
allows are the standard HTML names that DOMPurify allows by default), the resource limits other than
`maxTextSize` and `maxEdges`, the diagnostics, hints and codes, and the tests are original work of this repository.
The test fixtures are original diagrams. The upstream vectors under `Fixtures/upstream-vectors/` of the tests
are generated from the pinned mermaid and khroma by `benchmarks/visual-diff/mermaid/gen-theme-vectors.mjs` and
`gen-flowchart-vectors.mjs` (whose flowchart texts in `flowchart-vector-cases.mjs` are original) and
`gen-shape-vectors.mjs` (single nodes of every shape and label kind, measured in headless Chrome with the bundled
Liberation Sans) and `gen-curve-vectors.mjs` (point sets drawn by d3-shape's line generator with every edge curve);
their
inputs are original, and their expected values are the results of those MIT-licensed projects. The dagre stage
goldens (`dagre-layouts.json`) are generated from dagre-d3-es by `benchmarks/visual-diff/mermaid/gen-dagre-goldens.mjs`
on graphs from a seeded generator, so their inputs are original too. The dagre unit tests under `Dagre/` include cases
ported from the test files of dagre-d3-es (`*.test.js`, MIT, same copyright notices as `LICENSE-dagre.txt`). The
JavaScript key order of `ObjectKeyMap` (`Graphlib/`) follows the ECMAScript specification, and the work budget of
`LayoutWorkMeter` (`Dagre/`) is original.
